correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive face predicates agree for all 32768 edge subsets; 1858 admissible faces. The explicit lexicographic 896-pair ordinary gradient is acyclic on 1857 nodes and all 7440 incidence edges. Augmented integer Morse cancellation retains 14 degree-three and 50 degree-four generators; its exact 14x14 minor determinant is -1 and the CW attaching maps lie in pi_3 of a wedge of 14 S3, hence 36 S4 remain. Direct mod2 and mod3 simplicial rank checks agree. Two independent complete fixed-simplex/orbit-formula S6 character computations and orthogonal Specht decomposition establish the five multiplicity-one irreps, with one invariant line. Actual embedded verifier script was executed and its printed output included.

The five multiplicity-one Specht factors, full conjugacy-class trace vector and unique invariant line are a natural exact equivariant refinement, useful for distinguishing label symmetries and testing equivariant conjectures; not an arbitrary numeric slice.
